title: Expressing cos(3*pi/2 + x) in Terms of sin x and cos x
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Express the quantity \cos(3\pi/2 + x) in terms of \sin x and \cos x.

steps.title: Apply the Cosine Addition Formula
steps.explanation: Expand cos(3*pi/2 + x) using cos(A + B) = cos A cos B - sin A sin B.
steps.why: The cosine sum formula applies to A = 3*pi/2 and B = x.

steps.title: Evaluate Cosine and Sine at 3*pi/2
steps.explanation: The point on the unit circle at angle 3*pi/2 is (0, -1).
steps.why: On the negative y-axis, the x-coordinate is 0 and the y-coordinate is -1.

steps.title: Substitute and Simplify
steps.explanation: Substitute 0 and -1 to conclude that cos(3*pi/2 + x) = sin x.
